# Review — cid-tiradas-83-83a (tirada 83, first part, lines 1385–1452 with 1385b)

Adversarial review against the pinned packet, Pidal's rubric and footnotes on the scan (PDF pp. 223–227 read at
200 dpi, with crops at 400 and 600 dpi of the note to v. 1394, of f[ó]remos / [i] at vv. 1409–11, of Álbar at
vv. 1414, 1439, 1442), conventions.md, the pilot (01-04), the published parts (10-14, 32-34, 35-39, 44-48, 75-77,
78-82 in particular), the established texts of earlier parts (for every cross-reference), the shared glossary
and known-forms.json. All edits made by script (json load/dump, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1). No `t` changed:
the 69 `t` lines concatenated with "\n" equal the packet's 69 verses (1385, 1385b, 1386–1452) in order exactly,
checked by script before and after the edits; one `l` line per `t` line in all 25 units.

Checked and found sound (no change):
- Rubric against the scan (p. 219): Minaya va a Cardeña por doña Jimena. Más castellanos se prestan a ir a Valencia.
  —Minaya en Burgos. Promete a los judíos buen pago de la deuda del Cid.—Minaya vuelve a Cardeña y parte con
  Jimena.—Pedro Vermúdez parte de Valencia para recibir a Jimena. En Molina se le une Avengalvón. Encuentran a
  Minaya en Medinaceli. The first note quotes the first three sections and assigns the rest to part 83b: right.
  Assonance á with á-e endings counting: re-derived, right. The tirada runs on after v. 1452 (Direvos de los
  cavalleros …, p. 223), as the last note says.
- Footnotes against the scan, wording and verse numbers right: 1385 (ane por an, damos una muestra de e
  paragógica en estos versos), 1388 (ser en pro / andar en pro, 1913, 2054, 'tratar del provecho de uno, serle
  favorable y amigo'), 1389 (perderave por perderá, al uso arcaico; los romances dirían perderáe), 1394 (apart
  from diçiendo: 'descendido' del caballo; 1756, 1842; the traveller prays first; 2928–29), 1396 (1748, 3036; Auto
  de los Reyes Magos, Alexandre; 2890), 1397 (verbo vicario 'también curie'; Helo, helo por do viene), 1400
  (comp. 1408, 'os ha dejado libres'), 1405 ('despachó, envió', 1159), 1413 ('y cuidarán de ello', 3251; Bertoni
  and Adam not carried, harmless), 1427 ('vestidos y aderezo de una persona'), 1434 ('perdonaríamos los intereses
  con tal que nos devolviese el capital'), 1436 ('merced, favor'; 'habrá buen pago'; the poet never remembers the
  Jews again — Pidal's "págs. 35–36 y 85" not carried, harmless), 1449 (above), 1382 (Medinaceli, limit of his
  kingdoms; on p. 219). "Pidal gives no note" on 1410–12 and 1444–46: right (pp. 225–227 have no such notes).
- Italics confirmed on the image: so consejo preso ane, Bivar[e], far[e], perdera[ve], pesar[e], [fo] torn[ar],
  [a dos las iffantes], f[ó]remos (the ó slanted, 400 dpi), [i], quiere[n], Xim[e]na, pie[de]s, [Campeador]. The
  label 1385b printed on p. 220.
- Cross-references checked against the established texts: v. 10 (pienssan de), 68 (conducho), 85–212 (the arcas),
  226 (de veluntad), 246–56 (Ximena left with abbot Sancho), 262 (afevos), 671 (de prestar), 688 (rictad, Pidal
  'riqueza' as 32-34), 1284 (ciento omnes le dio … a Álbar Fáñez), 1285–86 (mill marcos, [quinientos] to the
  abbot), 1309 (adeliñó), 1356 (yo les mandaré dar conducho), 1372–77 (the Infantes' talk), 1380 (portero),
  1382 (Medina).
- Grammar labels checked and right: fagades, saludadnos, quiera (relative + subjunctive), Respuso, a (impersonal
  aver), Ido es / Idos son, tórnansse, quandol, se fo tornar (ir + inf.), Omillom, curie / curiare, ffaga,
  Salúdavos, sueltas me vos ha (participle agreeing), levaros, viesse, serié / avrié, mande, enviólos, Dezid,
  f[ó]remos (future subjunctive), mandó, remaneçió, Veriedes, toviesse, diziendo (bare gerund), feré,
  acreçídol han, se tenié, aduxiera (-ra pluperfect), dezir vos he (split future), pensólas de adobar, parescan,
  adobadas las ha, Desfechos nos ha, val, soltariemos, lieva, avedes fecho, Dixo (sg. for the pair), ir lo hemos
  buscar, se le acogen, penssó, vala, besad, quiera olbidar, fer lo he, Yas espiden, felos.
- Names in `i`: Minaya Álvar Fáñez / Álvar Fáñez (Albar/Álbar kept in `l`), Ximena, San Pedro, Valencia, Vivar,
  Medinaceli for Medina (as 78-82 at v. 1382), the Campeador, my Çid.
- `l` ↔ `i` unit by unit: sense and force agree; no remembered English found.

Findings refused:
- 1385 `i` "had taken their counsel" for preso ane (present perfect): epic tense-mixing, the English past reads
  naturally with "rode along". Left.
- 1442 `i` "So may the Creator help you": 78-82 has "keep", 44-48 "protect", 32-34 "help"; the published parts
  already vary, and "help" is the plainest sense of valer. Left.
- 1410 `i` "Fifteen days from now": agrees with the (now hedged) note's "i.e."; the hedge sits in the note. Left.
- 1386 note "The Infantes' courtesy is not idle": interpretive, but grounded in vv. 1372–77 just before. Left.
- 1385 note "keeping the traditional count undisturbed": the reason for the b-number is inference, but sound
  (Pidal's restored half-line splits one manuscript line in two). Left.
- 1417 note gives tener pro without a hedge while the gloss hedges: the sense from context ('be of use to them',
  cf. aver pro v. 1380) is secure enough for the note. Left.

(sueltas/penssarán and ha/preso/de are counted as one style change per row: 18 = 3 + 7 + 8.)

Checked: gloss keys (52, excluding __broaden__) equal the novel-forms.json keys exactly. Every __broaden__ value
(17 after the edits: val, lieva, ha, que, por, en, cabdal, pesar, mande, mi, aguardar, quiera, tenié, veré, de,
preso, dio) begins with the known-forms.json entry verbatim + " · " (checked by script). All tokens of the 69
lines (brackets stripped, lowercased, apostrophe splitting) are covered by known + gloss. The glosser's flagged
items: cosiment, sermos, guarnimientos, acogen, deçido, ffaga, aguardar fixed as above; toviesse, fóremos, the
"de" broaden and acreçídol checked (below). Other entries checked and right: ane, saludadnos, bivare, fare,
pesare, tórnansse, quandol, vieron, assomar, ssan, acabó, salúdavos, onde, dexé, levaros, heredad, sanas,
enviólos, dezid, curiare, remaneçió, irse, rogavan, diziendo, feré, mejores, mulas, parescan, adobadas, desfechos,
soltariemos, dexaremos, besad, levarlo, felos; broadens val (present 3rd sg. not in the old entry), lieva,
que ('what'), por ('as'), en (+ infinitive), cabdal (noun), pesar (infinitive), mande (3rd sg. optative),
mi (stressed after a preposition), quiera (bien querer), tenié (se tenié), veré (veer con).

Findings refused:
- toviesse "the exact force of tener pro is uncertain": no note in Pidal; a mild hedge, harmless. Kept.
- fóremos "seer / ir … while we travel": the unit reads 'be'; the entry offers both, as the 78-82 foren entry
  does. Kept.
- acreçídol: lemma acreçer, participle + enclitic le, = le han acrecido — right. Kept.
- __broaden__ de: 'within' of a time limit is the most likely reading and is hedged; de veluntad and the
  partitive arguably fall under the old entry's 'manner' and 'partitive' senses, but the additions are accurate.
  Kept.
- __broaden__ lieva: 'carries off' versus 'brings' is a narrow difference, but the old entry does not give the
  neutral 'take, bring'. Kept.
- pro (sodes pro) as an adjective: the old entry's 'worth, merit; de pro "worthy"' covers it closely enough; no
  broaden added.

## Readings left uncertain

- v. 1385 so consejo preso ane: what the Infantes have resolved (presumably the match of vv. 1372–77); the half-line
  is Pidal's restoration.
- v. 1403 todo serié alegre: todo adverbial ('all glad') or subject ('all would be glad').
- v. 1410 De aquestos quinze días: 'within' or 'fifteen days from now'; no note.
- v. 1411 sermos: its formation (= seremos).
- v. 1412 quantas buenas ellas han: whether buenas means 'of rank' or simply 'good', and how many are meant.
- v. 1438 ir lo hemos buscar: lo 'him' (the Çid) or 'it' (the money).
- v. 1441 al partir del abbat: 'parting from the abbot' or 'the abbot's leave-taking'.
- vv. 1444–46: the construction of todos los días del sieglo en levarlo adelant … valdrá más; no note.

## Text observations for the establishing run (no `t` changed)

- v. 1442 "Minaya Albar Fáñez": pinned unaccented; at 600 dpi the A has the low symmetric apex of the unaccented
  letter, unlike the Álbar of v. 1439 on the same crop. Pinned text right.
- v. 1414 Álbar, v. 1405 Dio (unaccented; dió at 1422), v. 1443 por mi (unaccented): pinned text agrees with the
  print.
- No misreading of the established text found in this part.
